reason: Refuted as a build for 28-29 Sep (this agrees with the finding's own 'do not build'). VALUE: (1) The output niche is the one the DaughterNet insertion already owns: a parent that kept one child, plus an in-degree-0 start at t+1 within the safe geometry. Insertion cap 6 (probe 45, 0.956) already fills it with a learned score. ILP-fork restore is a second, lower-quality candidate source for the same parents and the same per-video cap. (2) The source is at break-even. I-049 / exp12 put ILP fork precision at 36/241 = 0.149 at weight 1.2 and 24/127 = 0.19 at 0.6. Those numbers are in-sample, from the exp03B pipeline and the pre-patch metric. The post-insertion break-even is q* = 0.161, so the expected sign is 0 +- noise. The 'restorable' subset (c2 still an in-degree-0 start after the relink) is unmeasured and may be empty. (3) Division adds of the same class read flat on the LB: DC 0.20/0.225 gave 0.954 (probes 43/44) and DC 0.30 gave 0.949. The lab has been wrong in sign for division knobs. (4) The link to John Taylor's result is speculation. exp85b (ILP 0.4 on exp70g) moved +49 nodes (+0.04%) and forks 81 -> 84, with lowrefine unchanged (CONTEXT 06:26Z). JT's +0.001 is equally explained by his undisclosed stage or by node supply. FEASIBILITY: there is no replay bed (the exp60 edge_cache holds 0 ILP edges), so no honest local gate. A lab needs a GPU rerun (~7-8 h of the weekly quota). The x138 relink (cell 5 l.1943-1951, 'if motion_edges: edges = motion_edges') means the patch must carry the raw ILP edges through filter_output_graph, which is new code on the ship path with no measured counter. It could be made byte-identical when off, but with no lab it can only be judged by an LB slot. That slot is worth more on the E10 / cap-ladder / SEC / CI reads. Nothing is disclosed by another team, so aggressive mode does not make it actionable.
fix: None for 28-29 Sep. If it is ever revisited (only if JT says his stage keeps ILP forks), do not re-add edges raw. Feed the ILP forks into the existing divinsert candidate list, scored by DaughterNet under the same cap, so they compete with the insertion instead of stacking on it. Run a counter-only dummy first (kill if < 0.5 restorable per clip, or if > 50% overlap with insertion parents). It must be byte-identical when off (sha256 == the exp70g dummy CSV) and fail-soft inside the safetail deadline guard.
realistic_gain: ~0 on public (0 +- 0.001, below the 3-decimal LB resolution); private sign unknown, at best +0.0005. It would cost one LB slot and a GPU lab it cannot honestly pass.
